title: Register a new business
summary: Register a newly started business through the Business Permits and Licensing Office / Business One Stop Shop.
providerOffice: Business Permits and Licensing Office / Business One Stop Shop

requirements.name: Location sketch of the new business
DTI/SEC/CDA certificate
requirements.whereToSecure: Department of Trade and Industry / Securities and Exchange Commission / Cooperative Development Authority

requirements.name: Certificate attesting to tax exemption, if the business is tax exempt
Zoning certification that the business location complies with zoning regulations
Tax clearance showing municipal tax obligations have been paid
Three passport-size pictures of the owner/operator, or the applicable managing partners / president / general manager
Health certificate for all food handlers

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.details: Use the official Bauang eLGU portal and submit or upload the required information and documents.

steps.title: Pay assessed business tax and fees
steps.details: Payment may be made over the counter; the source also identifies LANDBANK Link.BizPortal for online payment.

steps.title: Claim the business permit
steps.details: The office issues the business permit and other applicable permits or clearances after processing.

fees.label: Business tax and other fees
fees.notes: Amount depends on capitalization and the Municipality of Bauang Revenue Code schedule of fees.

processingTime: Up to 3 working days for a simple transaction.

provenance.notes: Consolidates the walk-in and online new-business variants published in the current-listed BPLO Citizen's Charter PDF. The PDF does not expose a visible edition year.

title: Renew a business permit
summary: Renew an existing business registration for the ensuing calendar year.
providerOffice: Business Permits and Licensing Office / Business One Stop Shop

requirements.name: Copies of the annual or quarterly tax
Two copies of receipts showing payment of regulatory fees
Certificate of exemption from local taxes or fees, if exempt

steps.title: Submit the requirements
steps.details: Provide the required documents and information for review, verification, and assessment.

steps.title: Pay the assessed tax and fees
steps.details: Pay the computed business tax and other fees and obtain the official receipt.

steps.title: Claim the renewed permit
steps.details: The office issues the business permit and other applicable permits or clearances.

fees.label: Business tax and other fees
fees.notes: Amount depends on capitalization and the Municipality of Bauang Revenue Code schedule of fees.

provenance.notes: Current-listed BPLO Citizen's Charter PDF reviewed; the PDF does not expose a visible edition year.
